title: SOC2 field notebook — Omar
body:
Quick brain-dump for SOC2 prep; very messy, for my personal tracing. Use this to convert to proper control mapping doc later.

Background/context:
- Working through scoping for SOC2 Type 1 (targeting Q2 audit window). Focus: Hosted API + Dedicated; Private deployment scoping optional (customer-managed infra). Need to confirm which org units will be in-scope.
- Primary risks I see: data leakage in logs, key material misuse, misconfigured private deployments, weak segregation between tenant workloads on Dedicated.

Open questions (high priority):
1) Scope confirmation: Do we include proof-of-concept Dedicated customers who are on trial? How do we treat staging clusters used by Prod-like testing? Need product ops answer. (Ask @Lena)
2) KMS/HSM: For Hosted, we currently use cloud KMS for key wrapping. Do we have customer-provided key flow documented for Private? Evidence path unclear.
3) Access reviews cadence: Engineering does monthly role review in theory — is there an artifact (email or ticket) to prove it? If not, start monthly checklist tickets.

Control mapping scratch (very rough):
- CC Access Controls -> Technical: IAM roles + Okta SSO -> Artifacts: Okta audit export + IAM group membership CSV + onboarding/offboarding tickets (JIRA-PEOPLE-*)
- CC System Config -> Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) + PR review policy -> Artifacts: GitHub org repo PR history, CODEOWNERS, terraform state snapshots + merge approval logs
- CC Key Management -> Cloud KMS usage + rotation policy -> Artifacts: KMS rotation schedule (calendar event), KMS audit logs, design doc on HSM requirement for Private
- CC Change mgmt -> Release engineering runbooks + rollback playbooks -> Artifacts: release checklist, post-release incident notes (SRE-runbooks/RCAs)

Evidence to collect (by owner):
- Okta: full org export (owner: People Ops) -> next steps: request audit export for last 12 months; preserve as CSV.
- Terraform: list of repos flagged as prod; export PR review approvals (owner: infra/pr-engineering).
- KMS: rotation policy doc + last rotation event (owner: infra-security).
- Private deployments: network diagram showing customer-managed network boundary + KMS integration flow (owner: private-deployments eng lead).

Immediate TODOs (this week):
- Send quick scope questions to Product Ops and Sales to freeze which customers are in-scope for Type 1 and whether Dedicated/Private count (action: email draft below).
- Create JIRA epic to track evidence collection per control (template: use CON-epic template in Confluence).
- Pull historical Okta org audit for last 6 months.

Email draft (to send):
Subject: SOC2 Scope confirmation + Trial Dedicated customers
Hi team — quick ask: for the SOC2 Type 1 audit target, do we include trial Dedicated customers and staging clusters in the scope? If you rely on staging for pre-prod, we need to flag those systems explicitly (and collect evidence for them). Please reply or add notes to the Confluence scope page.

Notes to self (random):
- We need tighter definition of what constitutes Prod tenant (billing tag + region). Could use billing project tagging policy.
- Audit evidence should prefer immutable exports (CSV/JSON) over screenshots.
- Keep everything time-stamped and stored in secure evidence bucket with restricted access. Maybe reuse existing SRE evidence bucket? Ask @Marco.

Risk matrix (quick):
- Risk: Log ingestion contains PII/tokenized data. Likelihood: medium. Impact: high. Mitigation: redact at ingest + central scrubber + retention policy 30d. Evidence: logging pipeline config + redact rule unit tests.
- Risk: Unauthorized access to model weights in Private deployments. Likelihood: low. Impact: high. Mitigation: KMS-wrapped model artifacts + role-based access + audit logs. Evidence: artifact storage ACLs + KMS logs.

Control test ideas (manual):
- Verify onboarding/offboarding: pick 3 recent hires and trace access removal timeline via Okta + cloud IAM.
- Configuration drift: sample 2 prod nodes and verify terraform drift detection results for last 90 days.
- KMS usage: sample 2 encryption operations and confirm audit entries.

Where to put cleaned deliverable: Confluence space under SEC > artifacts > evidence-YYYYQ2. Final artifact should include index mapping controls -> evidence file names.

Random implementation notes / snippets:
- Search for "kms rotation" in infra-security slack history for 2025-2026. Might be a thread with auditproof logs.
- GH PR #341 (infra) includes new CODEOWNERS changes; maybe useful as proof of review process.

Later TODO (post-scope):
- Build evidence checklist per control with explicit filename expectations and retention rules.
- Run tabletop with SRE/product for change mgmt scenarios (deploy rollback, hotfix).
- Draft control narrative for auditors: short paragraph per control describing how control works and where evidence lives.

End of dump. Will tidy after scope confirmed.

-- Omar K
